hooks.name: aidlc-guard-tool-call
hooks.description: Refuses the two shell calls a turn must not make: a first `next` that dropped the user's arguments the verb seam latched, and a bare advancing `next` in the same turn as a read-only command AIDLC already ran. PreToolUse because both must block, and the terminal spellings are matched because the adapter canonicalizes all three to Bash.
